description: List live, same-category alternatives to a well-known AI tool (e.g. 'chatgpt', 'notion-ai', 'figma'). Call this when a user asks 'what are the alternatives to X' or wants competitors/substitutes for a named product. `target` is the well-known tool's slug, not a listing slug from this catalog.

target.description: Slug of the well-known target tool, e.g. 'chatgpt'.

name: list_alternatives

target.description: null when the target slug is not a known product.

title: List alternatives to a tool
